description: This Java class 'DefaultReconnectConfig' provides the default implementation of configuration settings related to reconnect behavior in a messaging connectivity context. It manages parameters like initial delay, interval, read journal batch size, and rate configuration, and provides a static factory method to build instances from a Typesafe Config object.

classes.name: DefaultReconnectConfig
classes.description: An immutable class implementing reconnect configuration for messaging services, encapsulating delay durations, batch size, and rate configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultReconnectConfig based on provided Typesafe Config, reading specific reconnect settings.

methods.name: getInitialDelay
methods.description: Returns the initial delay duration before attempting to reconnect.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration between reconnection attempts.

methods.name: getReadJournalBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the batch size for journal reading during reconnection.

methods.name: getRateConfig
methods.description: Returns the rate configuration associated with reconnection.
